title: 6 nimmt! Online Free — Play the Bullhead Card Game with Friends | Bullheads
description: Looking for 6 nimmt! online? Bullheads is a free browser card game with the same 104-card rules. Private rooms for 2–10 friends, public matches and smart bots. No download, no sign-up.
h1: Looking for 6 nimmt! online? Play Bullheads free.
lead: Bullheads is a free online card game played with the classic 104-card rules you know from 6 nimmt!. Open a private room, send your friends a 4-letter code and play together in seconds — on phones, tablets or computers.

p: Everyone picks a card at the same time. Cards are placed from lowest to highest onto the row whose last card is closest below. Play the sixth card on a row and you take the five cards before it — and all their bullheads.
Cards lower than every row force you to take a row of your choice. After ten turns the player with the fewest bullheads wins. Want a longer game? Race to 66 keeps dealing hands until someone hits 66.
2 to 10 players per table, turn timers so nobody stalls, automatic reconnect if your phone drops, and Monte-Carlo bots on easy, normal or hard to fill empty seats or to practise alone.
It’s completely free. Everything that affects play is free forever; an optional Plus upgrade only removes ads and adds cosmetic card styles.

sections.h2: How to start a game with friends
p: 1. Enter a name and pick a bull character. 2. Tap Private room. 3. Share the room code or link. 4. When everyone’s in, the host deals the cards.

disclaimer: Bullheads is an independent game and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by AMIGO Spiele. 6 nimmt!® is a registered trademark of AMIGO Spiele.

title: Take 5 Online Free — Bullhead Card Game for 2–10 Players | Bullheads
description: Play a free online version of the Take 5 / Take 6 bullhead card game. Same rules, 2–10 players, private rooms with friends or smart bots, no download.
h1: Play Take 5 style online — free, with friends or bots
lead: Love Take 5 or Take 6 at game night? Bullheads brings the same fast, sneaky bullhead card game to your browser. Share a room code and play with up to 10 friends, anywhere.

p: 104 cards, four rows, ten cards each. Everyone reveals a card at once, lowest goes first, and whoever plays the sixth card on a row takes the whole row. Fewest bullheads wins.

No app to install and no account needed. Public matchmaking seats you at a table instantly, bots fill any gaps, and a quick game takes about five minutes — perfect for a video call with friends or a break at work.

disclaimer: Bullheads is an independent game and is not affiliated with AMIGO Spiele or any publisher of Take 5!, Take 6! or 6 nimmt!®. Those names are trademarks of their respective owners.

description: 想在線上玩誰是牛頭王嗎？Bullheads 是與《誰是牛頭王》(6 nimmt!) 相同規則的免費 104 張牛頭卡牌遊戲。2–10 人，可開私人房和朋友連線，也能對戰電腦，免下載、免註冊。
h1: 誰是牛頭王 線上版：免費和朋友一起玩
lead: Bullheads 是免費的線上牛頭卡牌遊戲，使用和《誰是牛頭王》一樣的經典 104 張牌規則。開一個私人房間，把 4 碼房號傳給朋友，手機、平板、電腦都能馬上一起玩。

p: 所有人同時出一張牌，從最小的開始，放到「末張比它小且最接近」的那一列。誰放下某列的第六張牌，就要吃下前面五張牌和上面所有的牛頭。
如果你的牌比每一列都小，就要選一列收走。十回合後牛頭最少的人獲勝；想玩久一點可以選「搶 66 模式」，一直打到有人累積 66 個牛頭。
每桌 2 到 10 人、出牌倒數計時、斷線自動重連，還有簡單、普通、困難三種難度的 AI 電腦玩家，可以補空位，也能自己一個人練習。
完全免費。所有影響遊戲的內容永久免費，選購的 Plus 只會移除廣告並提供牌面造型。
1. 輸入名字並選一隻牛角色　2. 點「私人房間」　3. 分享房號或連結　4. 大家到齊後，房主按「開始發牌」。
